visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and a warm smile looks directly into the camera lens. He is wearing a dark checkered shirt over a white t-shirt. He holds up a small, sleek black cylindrical object, resembling a luxury lipstick case, showing it off with a gentle, inviting expression. The background is a simple indoor setting with soft lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot in a bathroom. The man stands near a bathtub, still holding the black lipstick and a small yellow lighter. He carefully twists the lipstick to reveal its dark red tip. His movements are deliberate, suggesting he is preparing a romantic surprise. He wears a digital watch with a fabric strap. (3) The camera focuses on a white bathtub filled with pale blue-tinted water. Several small, delicate purple flowers float on the surface. The man's hands reach into the frame, gently scattering more of these tiny blossoms across the water's surface, creating a serene and aesthetically pleasing scene. (4) A young woman with long brown hair and glasses, wearing a light brown vest over a white collared shirt, enters the bathroom. The man stands behind her, covering her eyes with his hands before revealing the flower-filled bath. She smiles broadly, looking touched and surprised by the gesture. (5) The man presents the red lipstick to the woman. She takes it and examines it closely, but her expression turns from joy to confusion or slight disappointment. The man reacts with an exaggerated look of shock or realization, his mouth agape. The video fades to black with a Chinese text overlay at the center.
